items.stem: How does a BIM model primarily differ from a traditional 2D CAD drawing?

options.text: It is a data-rich, object-based model carrying information, not just lines representing geometry
options.rationale: Correct: BIM objects carry data, unlike plain geometric lines.

options.text: It can only ever be viewed in black and white
options.rationale: Colour is not the distinguishing feature of BIM.

options.text: It removes the need for any coordination between disciplines
options.rationale: BIM supports coordination; it does not remove the need for it.

options.text: It is simply a larger paper drawing
options.rationale: BIM is a data model, not a bigger drawing.

items.explanation: Correct: BIM objects carry data, unlike plain geometric lines.

items.stem: Which TWO are purposes of a common data environment (CDE)? (Select TWO.)

options.text: To provide a single, managed source of project information
options.rationale: Correct: a CDE centralises and manages project information.

options.text: To control the status and sharing of information between parties
options.rationale: Correct: a CDE manages information status and sharing.

options.text: To automatically design the building without input
options.rationale: A CDE stores and manages information; it does not auto-design.
A CDE supports the team; it does not replace it.

items.explanation: Correct: a CDE centralises and manages project information.

items.stem: A clash report lists hundreds of clashes. What is the best next step before a coordination meeting?

options.text: Filter and prioritise clashes by significance so real conflicts are addressed first
options.rationale: Correct: prioritising by significance focuses effort on real issues.

options.text: Treat all clashes as equally critical and fix them randomly
options.rationale: Not all clashes matter equally; many are tolerances or duplicates.

options.text: Delete the clashing elements from the model
options.rationale: Deleting elements hides problems rather than resolving them.

options.text: Ignore the report because software found the clashes
options.rationale: Automated detection still needs human review and resolution.

items.explanation: Correct: prioritising by significance focuses effort on real issues.
